title_en: Ferraro, Worrie Capture Finger Lakes Meet Titles
description: The 2026 Thoroughbred racing season at Finger Lakes ended Nov. 25. Anthony Ferraro completed the meet with 68 victories to secure his third consecutive Finger Lakes training title and fifth overall. Andre Worrie was the leading jockey.

title_en: Proletariat Going for Hollywood Ending to Fine Campaign
description: Frey hopes for a kinder, gentler pace this time around for Proletariat in Del Mar's $300,000 Hollywood Derby (G1T) after a tough loss last time out when he was pressured through fast fractions in the Twilight Derby (G2T) at Santa Anita Park.

title_en: McPeek 'Highly Optimistic' About Upcoming Oaklawn Meet
description: Trainer Kenny McPeek says two of his top young horses, Twinkle Town and Mystik Bayou, could run at Oaklawn "before the winter's out."

title_en: Louisiana Stewards Reaffirm Cox's Six-Month Suspension
description: Louisiana stewards have reaffirmed a six-month suspension for trainer Brad Cox following a lidocaine positive from Life of Joy after her victory in the March 21 Fair Grounds Oaks (G2), and referred a defense motion to dismiss to the state commission.

title_en: Co-Founder Luke Murrell Departs Australian Bloodstock
description: Australian Bloodstock will enter a new era in 2027, with co-founder Luke Murrell departing the operation and Jamie Lovett looking to expand the business under a new ownership structure.

title_en: Overpass Seeks Third Winterbottom Stakes Victory
description: The Bjorn Baker-trained Overpass has landed barrier 1 and is the AU$3.20 favorite in the Nov. 28 Winterbottom Stakes (G1), having won two Quokkas and two previous editions of the race from seven starts at the Perth track.

title_en: White Abarrio Lawsuit: CHRB Promises Better Cooperation
description: The scratch of White Abarrio from the 2025 Breeders' Cup Dirt Mile (G1) has yielded a commitment from the California Horse Racing Board to improve its procedures before a determination is made whether to scratch a horse at the gate.

title_en: Longtime Trainer David Vance Dies at Age 86
description: Multiple grade 1-winning trainer David Vance has died at the age of 86. The Indiana native trained Thoroughbreds for 58 years and retired in the summer of 2023.

title_en: Illinois Trainer Castro Receives Additional Sanctions
description: The Horseracing Integrity and Welfare Unit has suspended Illinois-based trainer Isidro Castro for two years and fined him $25,000 following a violation involving possession of a syringe containing a banned substance at Fairmount Park.

title_en: HISA Suspends Four Trainers for Needles, Injectables
description: Four trainers, Jaime Castellanos, Carl Deville, Kassie Gladd, and Juan Lopez, have been fined and suspended by HISA for violations involving possession of hypodermic needles, syringes, or injectable medications on racetrack grounds.

title_en: Traveling Concepcion Named Jockey of the Week
description: Axel Concepcion, the 2023 Eclipse Award winner as Outstanding Apprentice, commuted between Churchill Downs and Fair Grounds posting victories in two Fair Grounds stakes, seven wins overall, and two multiple-win days.

title_en: Tam Tam Continues Championship Chase in Mrs. Revere
description: Continuing her late-season push for the 3-year-old filly Eclipse Award, Tam Tam matches up with Sister Troienne for the first time in the $300,000 Mrs. Revere Stakes (G2T) Nov. 27 at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Siblings to Group Winners Among Tatts Sapphire Catalog
description: A number of well-related yearlings, foals, and mares feature among 240 entries for the Tattersalls Ireland Sapphire Sale Dec. 15. The sale has received strong support, with the number of foals cataloged increasing from 62 in 2025 to 160 this year.

title_en: Doublecents Tops Oaklawn's Opening-Day Hot Springs
description: A blowout winner on the last day of the 2025-26 Oaklawn meeting, Doublecents resurfaces on the first day of the new Oaklawn meet in the Nov. 27 Hot Springs Stakes for 3-year-olds at a mile.

title_en: Takethemoneyhoney Gets Class Test in Chilukki Stakes
description: On Nov. 29, the closing day of the fall meet at Churchill Downs, Maryland-bred standout Takethemoneyhoney ventures into graded company for the first time in her 12th career start, competing in the $300,000 Chilukki Stakes (G3) at Churchill Downs.

title_en: Americathegreat Seeks Graded Repeat in Jockey Club Oaks
description: Gary Barber and D. J. Stable's 3-year-old daughter of Curlin won the Sands Point Stakes (G3T) last out. Bless Her, who ran second in the Sands Point by half a length, also is in the Jockey Club Oaks field.

title_en: Man o'War Stakes Makes Its November Debut at Belmont
description: The Man o'War Stakes (G2T) has had a somewhat nomadic life on the New York Racing Association's stakes schedule.

title_en: Funtastic Carries On More Than Ready's Legacy
description: In this week's Porter on Pedigrees, Three Chimneys Farm's Funtastic is carrying on the legacy of the late More Than Ready.

title_en: Podcast Playback: Quotes of Interest From Nov. 18-24

title_en: Hill Prince Rematch Highlights Jockey Club Derby
description: The leaves may have fallen from trees and kids are talking about Santa Claus but, at Belmont Park, there's time for one big, final dose of black-type turf racing.

description: At the end of the day of trade, 95 of 154 lots sold for turnover of 1,154,500 guineas, down 31% year-on-year, and at an average of 12,153 guineas, down 18% from last year. The median came out at 9,500 guineas.

title_en: Joseph Bids for Sixth Straight Championship Meet Title
description: Saffie Joseph Jr. will launch his bid to capture a sixth consecutive Championship Meet training title Nov. 26 Thanksgiving Day, at Gulfstream Park's highly anticipated winter Thoroughbred meet.

description: Juddmonte's unbeaten Consequent will take on eight fillies and mares in the $300,000 Falls City Stakes (G3) on Thanksgiving, Nov. 26, at Churchill Downs. The 3-year-old Into Mischief filly looks to improve to 5-for-5.

description: Andy Schweigardt has been named chair of the North American International Cataloguing Standards Committee, succeeding Carl Hamilton.

title_en: Leading European Stallion Zarak Dies at 13
description: Zarak, one of Europe's leading stallions, has died at aged 13 following a fatal accident at Haras de Bonneval, the Aga Khan Studs announced Nov. 24.

title_en: Doppelganger, Verifying Lead Pleasant Acres' Roster
description: Doppelganger and Verifying will both lead the Pleasant Acres Stallions 2027 roster at $10,000. Verifying first foals will be 2-year-olds next year.
